#### Modern Marvels (1995) - S05E31 - More Engineering Disasters

- When ice coated the cage device preventing emergency blow in the Thresher submarine, the vessel imploded at 8,400 feet, so small mechanical oversights in critical components cause total system failure.
  - *→ chaos proofs (organs):* so my chaos_proofs organ should also test for environmental conditions on critical components.
- When engineers dismissed dam leaks as 'normal' despite visible seepage, the St. Francis Dam collapsed killing 400 people, so ignoring early warnings in routine maintenance causes preventable disasters.
- When Liberty ships' steel became brittle in Arctic temperatures, hulls cracked causing 40 ships to break in half, so environmental conditions can make standard materials fail catastrophically.

#### Modern Marvels (1995) - S06E30 - The Maginot Line

- When France built the Maginot Line's 'Metro' train for ammunition transport and advanced air filtration systems, it demonstrated technical sophistication but failed to account for the need for mobile defense against blitzkrieg tactics.
  - *→ capability ledger (organs):* so my capability_ledger organ should also require that at least one mode per capability is designated as mobile or adaptable.
- When France prioritized static fortifications like the Maginot Line over mobile warfare, it created a fatal gap in the Ardennes that Germany exploited to bypass the line entirely.
- When French propaganda falsely claimed the Maginot Line was 'invincible' with an 'unbreachable' underground rail network, it created overconfidence that sapped military morale and led to surrender without combat.

#### Modern Marvels (1995) - S06E31 - Physical Fitness Quest For Muscle

- When Bob Hoffman challenged 'muscle binding' with a posing exhibition at Springfield College, the scientific community accepted resistance training — so evidence overcomes entrenched myths.

- When Joe Weider's magazines inspired Lou Ferrigno to overcome hearing loss through weightlifting, they created a bodybuilding career — so media shapes identity through accessible role models.
- When Muscle Beach regulars defied 'muscle binding' warnings by weight training openly, their visible results contradicted the myth — so community practice validates evidence over fear.
